# goslop text fixture — broad catch that counts a failure and moves on stays
# reportable (WeThePeople jobs/detect_story_outcomes.py:302 TP shape)
lang: python
file: count_continue.py
---
def run(items):
    last_exc = None
    for item in items:
        try:
            process(item)
        except Exception as exc:
            last_exc = exc
            continue
    return last_exc
